bio.text: Kwame Raoul is the Attorney General of Illinois; he was sworn in as the state's 42nd Attorney General in 2019 and began a second term on January 9, 2023.
He was born in Chicago to Haitian immigrants.
Before becoming Attorney General, he worked as a Cook County prosecutor, was a partner at two national corporate law firms, and served 14 years as an Illinois state senator.
